sense.text:
Nuclear war, environmental pollution and resource rape are all threats to our survival, and all of them come from Caucasoid behavior, Caucasoid values and Caucasoid psychology. The only nation that has used nuclear weapons on anybody dropped them on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and over 200,000 people died from two bombs, and that was only those two cities; some 26 million Russians died in that war, which they do not like mentioning. As Bishop said, when people say black on black crime is the biggest thing in America, remind them of the wars they fought and what they have done to our people. Black on black violence is bad and we should not be killing one another, but the man really killing people is the white man. They own the corporations whose chimneys pump fumes all day, every day, and then blame your little car, hairspray and cow farts. They divided Africa at the Berlin Conference and from that day till today they have been raping that land for gold, bauxite, oil and lithium, while our people dig for it with their bare hands. Who builds a weapon that can kill everybody, himself included? A natural born killer, a man telling you he will only give up power by wiping everybody out.

They call themselves Caucasians, French Caucasian, German Caucasian, British, American, Italian Caucasian, because they all came from the Caucasus Mountains. They are the real cavemen. The so-called white man's real name is Esau; he is an Edomite, red and very hairy. We made the mistake of letting them come around us: we bathed them, shaved them, educated them and showed them how to dress, and when we started sinning against our maker they got the upper hand over us. Now we are their slaves. Job shows they were the cave people.

“But now they that are younger than I have me in derision”: everybody knows Esau came out first, yet they are the younger, because they are the last nation to take rulership on this planet.

“Whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock”: they were not good enough to sit down with our dogs. Maybe that is why they love dogs so much: they sat in the Caucasus Mountains watching our fine hunting dogs, and now that they have the power they keep their dogs over us and treat their dogs better than they treat us.
“For want and famine they were solitary”: they did not live among us. They were “fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.”

“Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.” That is why, when they came to America and saw all that food, and when they went to Africa and saw all that food, they said, we need everything, we are going to take everything.
“They were driven forth from among men”: we were the men, they were the Neanderthal, and we drove them away from us. “They cried after them as after a thief”: they could not come around us.

“To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.” It is not that the Bible says it and you cannot find it: go to the Caucasus Mountains and you will find the caves. Originally they lived in mount Seir. They love caves; they are cave dwellers. You have never seen a black caveman. The bone structure, everything, the Neanderthal is the so-called white folks.

“Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.” In the Thirteenth Tribe book, one tribe used to sit together and eat lice off of each other's bodies, and until today they get lice.

Their own video on the origin of the Caucasian shows them very hairy all over: the albinos and the beasts of Europe, whom the Moors fought for hundreds of years. We ruled Europe; we were the knights in the castles with the swords, and they were the ones fighting to take the castles, which eventually they did. They kicked us out of Europe to São Tomé and Cape Verde, and when they really had power they came to America and conquered our brothers the natives, and went back to Africa and got us again. Take away their razor and they go right back to that look.

All of that happened because of our sins. Never forget the real reason: we did not want the Most High to rule over us, so he put the basest of people over us. They are not the greatest or the smartest; almost everything they have, we invented, but they have convinced the world they are the brightest.

“They were children of fools, yea, children of base men”: you do not get any lower than the basement. Base men, with no understanding and no wisdom whatsoever. But today, because of our sins, they are over us. “They were viler than the earth.”

“And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.” Today we are their byword, monkeys, coons. They took over the world, and with that control they do whatever they want. But their name is Esau, and to understand them we have to know who Esau was.

Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife “because she was barren”, and the Lord heard him and Rebekah conceived. Any of you sisters that are barren, do not nag your husband; pray, and ask him to pray for you, because only the Lord can open your womb. Have faith and pray to the Lord.

“And the children struggled together within her”: we have been fighting since the belly. The division between us and them is always going to be there. Christianity fooled us into believing they can be changed and trusted. No, we cannot trust them, because it was ordained for them to be who they are.

“If it be so, why am I thus?” It was so bad she had to enquire of the Lord. Fathers know you can see the baby poking through the belly when it kicks; this was a full blown rumble in the jungle, Ali against Foreman in the belly, and she felt all of it.

“Two nations are in thy womb”: not the same people. They come out of the same belly, but they become two separate nations. “Two manner of people”: different mannerisms, different ways of doing things, different ways of thinking. They will not be the same type of individual.

“The one people shall be stronger than the other people”: we are the people that are stronger. It is a fact; look at European sports today, the French national soccer team, the German team, even Italy has a black player. Everybody realizes that if you want to win you have to get yourself some black guys.

“And the elder shall serve the younger”: we had dominion over them at one point.

“And the first came out red”: that had to be mentioned, because everybody was of the same complexion before. The Lord formed man of the dust of the ground, and everybody was brown, different shades of brown, so when Esau came out red they had to document it.

“All over like an hairy garment”: the true cavemen, red and hairy all over, as the video showed. They looked like animals.

“They called his name Esau”, which means wasted away is he: he came out of his mother's womb with no pigmentation, looking like a ghost. They are not white either; you have never seen a person the color white on this planet, only in the movies and Casper the ghost. Esau is red. Down south they call him a redneck: slap him, he's red; he drinks too much, he's red; he laughs too much, he's red; he's angry, he's red.

His brother came out and “his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob.” Notice they did not mention the brother's color. Why? Because Jacob was brown like everybody else, as Genesis 2:7 shows.

“Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”: that is his character. He loves bloody food; the food has to match his complexion. Steak tartare, meat rare and medium rare. We are not supposed to eat blood, so our food has to be cooked. Two manner of people. But the Negroes wanted to be just like their masters, so they started eating all the garbage Esau eats.

“Therefore was his name called Edom”: E-D-O-M, which means red. Esau's name was changed to Edom and he became the father of the Edomite nations, what you call today your friendly neighborhood so-called white man. The natural born killer who says, I come in peace, but leaves you in pieces. That is how Esau operates. Do not trust his words.

precepts.why:
“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”: the deeper you dig, the darker the earth gets. Even what they call red earth, like the clay-looking dirt in OKC, put your hand next to it and it is just a bright, vivid brown, not red. The old school Indian red crayon was brown too, and Indians are not red; the natives were black, as the book Black Indians shows. So man was made brown, and that is why Esau's red had to be written down and Jacob's color did not.

“And breathed into his nostrils the breath of life”: the breath of life is the Lord's statutes and commandments, the ones your Christian pastor tells you that you do not have to keep. When you are not keeping the Lord's statutes and commandments you are dead. As Proverbs 7:2 says, keep my commandments and live. If you want to have life you must keep God's laws; there are no two ways about it.

sense.text:
This shows another side of the story of Esau and Jacob, and that Esau is the Edomite, the so-called white man. “Behold, I have made him thy lord”: Jacob was made Esau's lord. The elder shall serve the younger.

“And all his brethren have I given to him for servants”: everybody on this planet is supposed to be our servants. It is our birthright; we are the rulers of this earth. The only way to get it back is to remember where we fell off and what we did wrong.

Christianity does not teach you what you did wrong; it wants you to stay in the wrong. Christianity is a continuation of slavery. Good cop, bad cop: the man whipping you was the bad cop, and Christianity was the so-called good cop that pacified you into accepting the rules of slavery. Keep whipping a man and one day he grabs the whip and whips you back, and they understood that, so they embedded Christianity in our brain so that we now willingly serve under white Jesus and white power. That is deep psychology; they think a thousand steps ahead. What really destroyed us is religion, and they use it to keep us divided: Seventh-day Adventist, Protestant, Pentecostal, Mormon, Jehovah's Witness. None of them teaches us who we are; they tell you, you are a Gentile. From which nation, then?

“And with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?” Isaac says, I gave him everything. He is your lord, everybody is his servant, the earth belongs to him. What else can I give you?
“Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.” That boy started crying: please give me your blessing.

“Thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth”: the best portions; he is going to live in the best parts of the earth. But everything was already given to Jacob. If Jacob already has everything, how is Esau going to get the best part of the earth? And “the dew of heaven from above” falls on the whole earth, which was already given to Jacob. So how can Esau acquire it?

“And by thy sword shalt thou live”: he gets all of these things by using the sword. He is a killer. But no matter where he goes he says, I come in peace, I just want to liberate your people, I feel like you have been oppressed. Meanwhile it is missiles after missiles, rape after rape, nothing but atrocities once you let them in. That is what democracy is about: now you can be a homo, a transgender, even a dog, and nobody can judge you. They are viler than the earth, as Job said. When they took control, evil increased on the earth.

“And it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”: a day was coming when they would have the dominion. That happened in the times of the Kings. We went back and forth: we had dominion again in 193 AD under Septimius Severus, wicked as that was, and lost it again in the Renaissance. Esau is going to have possession of the earth, and he is going to kill to get it.

“I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us?” God loves us, but looking at our condition, in the ghetto with everything going wrong, you would say, there is no way you love me.

“Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob”: Jacob and all his descendants, the twelve tribes, the whole nation of Israel.
“And I hated Esau”: Esau and all his nation. He “laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.”

“Whereas Edom saith”: it goes from Esau to Edom because Esau is the person whose name was changed to Edom, and he became the father of the Edomites.

“We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”: they were living in the Caucasus Mountains, in the caves, but they said they would come back and build. They did come back. It is called the Renaissance. They built major cities and took control of the whole earth.

“They shall build, but I will throw down”: God can throw down. Nobody can fight more than the Lord; they call him a god of war.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”: not he or him, but them. All of them are wicked. According to this verse there is not one righteous Edomite. Love it or hate it, nobody can make the Bible say what it does not say; once the Lord speaks, that is it.

“The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever”: the people, not the person, so all of them. Indignation is anger aroused by something unjust or unworthy, and Esau is both unjust and unworthy. Look at the justice system: a black man robs a store with a knife, nobody hurt, five years in jail; a white boy robs a store with a gun, somebody hurt, five years probation. He is unworthy because he was chosen from the beginning to be a vessel of wrath fitted for destruction. God created him to destroy him. His job is simple: to whip our behinds because we stepped out of line. That is only for a time; once the slavery is done, they are done.

And it is “for ever”: not for sometimes, not a little bit, but forever. If the Lord has indignation against them forever and they are the wicked of this earth, how are they going to be saved? That is how you know Christianity is a drug: people read this and still argue that Esau can be saved.

precepts.why: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” There is no argument: Esau is Edom. Esau came out red from his mother, hairy like a garment, his name was changed to Edom for the red pottage, and he dwelt in mount Seir. So when Malachi turns from Esau to Edom, it is the same man and the same nation.

“Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked”. There are many wicked people on this earth, but there is a principal wicked man, the one just read about in Malachi: Esau Edom, whom the Lord has indignation against forever. They are the border of wickedness; it starts and ends with them.

“The wicked doth compass about the righteous”: the wicked surround us. They are everywhere, in all our countries, and they run things. Brothers kill their own man for a corner, and the moment the police roll up they run. That was supposed to be your block.

“Therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.” How can anyone be convinced that an animal did that to a young man's skull? A sharp tool had to be used, and justice has still not been served, though the boy told his mother who would do it if anything happened to him. A man was put in a chokehold over selling loose cigarettes. Emmett Till was murdered because a woman said he whistled at her, and his mother kept the casket open so the world could see what they did to that boy. Kendrick Johnson, they say, rolled himself up in a mat; a white boy killed that kid over a white girl. The white woman is worse than the white man, because she uses him as a weapon: she only has to say things and things happen to you.

That is wrong judgment. Our people watch all of this happening, and class after class we bring the truth and nothing changes. We need to repent, and we have to separate from these people, or we are going to keep being judged like this.

sense.text:
“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things”: we had the whole earth and we were ungrateful children. The whole thing belonged to us and we murmured and murmured. The Lord delivered us out of Egypt, we watched plague after plague come upon Egypt, and we turned back and worshipped the same gods the Lord destroyed in Egypt.

Even today it is like pulling teeth to get us happy and joyous on a feast day. That has to change, because we did not have gladness before and that is why we went into captivity. Coming back to serve the Lord, if you want your strength, apply Nehemiah: the joy of the Lord is your strength. The blueprint is already set; the Bible tells you exactly how to live, but we do not want to listen.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”: not friends, enemies. “Which the Lord shall send against thee”: God himself sent them against us, because we did not want him as a ruler. Since you do not want me to rule over you, I am going to take the basemen and put them over you. First they whip you senselessly, torture you, tar and feather you, buck break you; they destroy you completely, and then they set up shop in your head with Christianity. You have to be brainwashed to believe Jesus is white with no Bible proof, while you carry the biggest Bible under your arm, keep one on your dashboard and one by your bedside, and cannot prove anything you believe.

The Pentecostals named their religion after the feast of Pentecost, so they read the feast, yet they do not keep it, while they gladly keep Christmas, the Fourth of July, Halloween, Valentine's Day and Thanksgiving, thanks killing, none of which they read in the Bible. Why? They are scared straight of white folks. Christians suffer from Stockholm syndrome: they love their oppressors and everything their oppressors do. Thank the Lord for saving a remnant, or we would all have been as Sodom and Gomorrah. Gangsters, homos and lesbians come out of that church, because once you serve another god, the Lord delivers you to vile affections. Keep staying in Christianity serving the false deity, or keep being a Muslim serving a rock, and do not be mad when the evil spirit jumps on you and you start defiling your body and changing kind. Your choir master makes songs dedicated to another deity, and the Lord is unhappy with that; he removes himself, and you see what happens.

“In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: we serve for food, for water, for clothes, for every kind of paperwork, because nothing is real in your life until the so-called white man says it is real. You are not even dead until there is a paper stamped by Esau Edom that says you are dead, and without it you cannot get the money your father left behind. Even the understanding you have of the Bible was taught to you by Esau, and that is why you do not have the right spirit on you: serve another Jesus and you get another gospel, and with the other gospel you get another spirit. That is why the little boys are twitching in the church. The only way out is to come out of these churches and join this movement. No weapons, no guns, no physical fight is going to save us; only this book, because the man we are up against was given the sword.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Christianity says the spiritual demon Satan put a yoke of iron on our necks. It never happened that way: history documents that a man did it, and the heads of the churches stood right there in agreement with him. The church and the slave masters were one entity with one purpose, to enslave us. We were whipped every day, allowed to go to church on Sundays, and whipped into accepting what they taught. Once we fully accepted Christianity, they took the yoke of iron off our necks, because by then we were well-trained good dogs: the Lord loves my master who whips me every day, and I will fight anybody that comes against my master. Until today we have that same mentality, and people cannot understand how the white man cannot be saved.

“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau”: there are fornicators and profane people, but nobody has reached the level of Esau when it comes to fornication and profaneness. He topped everybody. He is the one “who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.”

“When he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance”: none. That means he cannot be saved. “Though he sought it carefully with tears”: though he cried, he is not getting any. There is no salvation for the so-called white man.

precepts.why:
“The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree. Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel”. Repentance to Israel; there is no repentance for Esau. Israel means the Israelites, the children of the captivity, the children of the slave trade, the children of the colonization of Africa, not the fake people in the land right now.

“And forgiveness of sins”: we are able to be forgiven because the law was given only to us. It has nothing to do with them. Their only job is to whip us into shape. We are in punishment right now, like doing time in jail with them as the guards: do your time in peace and you will come out, but move the wrong way and they break your back.

Brothers who say we should gather guns and fight Esau do not understand that the Bible says the sword was his gift; the Lord gave him the sword. Read the name on your gun: Smith & Wesson, Springfield. The AK-47 is Russian, the Uzi is Israeli. We do not make guns. As Bishop Yahshua likes to say, all they have to do is cut the water in the hood. In Haiti a rich man sold a gang leader bullets, sent the police to make him shoot them all up, then sold him more. America will have a shootout with you, make you waste your bullets, and then you are dead. They dropped a bomb on the MOVE movement in Philly in 1985, and people forget Waco, Texas, where the Koresh movement, white people, an offshoot of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, were doing their own thing, and Esau came with tanks while there were children inside and bullets flying everywhere.

Stop playing. Your only defense against this man is the Bible. This is where you find your rest and your protection. We have to come back to the Lord and walk in righteousness, because that man does not know peace. All he knows is war, even though he loves saying the word peace, like his president who says he will be known as the most peaceful president ever. Forgiveness of sins and repentance are only for Israel.

sense.text:
As John Henrik Clarke showed, the African, the Indian and the Polynesian all invited the European to dinner, out of plenty and out of hospitality to strangers. Christopher Columbus wrote in his own diary that he wondered why they were so friendly, that they would be easier to conquer than he thought, that he wondered why they brought such small amounts of gold and where the mines were. Black people have not seen white people at all, because they are blinded by Christianity; Christianity has set up a satellite in their head so that slavery can continue. Every time you invite this man to dinner, he eats the food, kills you and takes your place. He says he comes in peace, and he leaves you in pieces. Columbus's memoir says exactly what the Bible says: they do not want a little bit, they want all of it.

You are dealing with a snake. You cannot charm him, talk to him or convince him to be anything other than what he was created to be. It is naive to think you will get into his politics and change things, that the man who got his nations by robbery and killing, under the false identity of Christians and Jews, wrote laws that let you vote him out. That is why Christianity is worse than crack: there is no better drug ever created, because what Christians believe makes no sense whatsoever. Why would a man who holds the rulership create laws that give you the power to get him out? It is the duplicity of lies of the Willie Lynch letter, avenue after avenue until you are dead. But a phenomenon occurred: the Israelite movement, with IUIC at the forefront as the vanguard of this truth.

“If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night”, “would they not have stolen till they had enough?” Regular thieves steal till they have enough: they are hungry, they grab a couple of bags of food, whatever they can carry, and they are out. “If the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?” But Esau is different.

“How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!” Esau is a whole different being. Like Columbus: that is a nice piece of gold, where did you get it, show me. He will not dig a few pieces; he will pick up the whole mountain and move it to his country, and when he cannot move the mountain, you are dead and it is his land now. That is what they did to us in Europe: they took everything of ours and took our names as well. Queen Elizabeth is not their name; they had no names.

Esau tastes the grape, says that is sweet, ships some home, plants the seed, and when it is not the same, he goes and takes the whole tree, then the land, then the whole country. He steals and steals and can never have enough. He is like the ocean: all the rivers and streams run into it and it is never filled. A never-ending hole. You cannot satisfy or please this man; all he wants is everything.

“All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border”: Esau is going to get the business from his own partners. The men in cahoots with him, the EU, are going to turn against Esau.

“The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.” They are so greedy they even turn on each other: Trump wants Greenland, which is part of his own confederacy, and he wants Canada. They can never, ever have enough.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: something is wrong with that man. He is not normal. The Most High created him messed up in the head.

“But the just shall live by his faith”: we are going to live by our faith.

“Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine”: the wine is lies, as Micah shows.

“He is a proud man”: hear how Trump talks, saying the prince of Saudi Arabia, Mohammed bin Salman, did not know he would have to kiss his ass one day. Who talks that way? The Lord does not lie: he chooses the basest of men and puts them in charge, and that man is a base man.

“Neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody's country. America always enters under the pretext of peace and democracy, to free the people, a peacekeeping mission. They went to Libya to liberate the people; Libya had free education, free health care, free housing, and now it has slave markets, and the people are broke, homeless and hungry. As a black American said in the video, Gaddafi was a man willing to help black people with billions and wanted to unite Africa under one currency, and after they knocked him off his chair slavery returned to Libya. Haiti is not the past, it is current; Venezuela is current. White people get real uncomfortable when you start talking about real history. They went to Iraq. In Haiti the peacekeepers left sickness, raped the children and dumped feces in the drinking water. In Syria they deposed Assad and put in a known terrorist. Behind the coups in Haiti was America, deposing elected presidents, because America loves dictators and puppets under its finger more than elected presidents. Before democracy and after democracy, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Yugoslavia: after America they lie in ruins, the soil poisoned by bombs and children born with birth defects. After invasion by peaceful America: Afghanistan, Syria, Bangladesh, Somalia, Yemen, Gaza, destroyed. America is not the author of peace but of war and destruction; now they have even renamed their department the Department of War. They speak as the lamb but they are the dragon. If they want peace on earth, all they have to do is disappear.

The US controls about 850 military bases, and surely more, in more than 90 countries. And there are more of his churches than military bases, because the real way to control us is through Christianity; we are more obedient to Christianity than to his military.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell”: he never has enough. He wants all the oil, in Venezuela, Iran and Iraq, and Greenland and Canada and all the natural resources. “And is as death”: wherever he goes people die. In Gaza they bomb and bomb and bomb: already over 600,000 people have died there, and a multitude of children. “And cannot be satisfied.”

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”: the great melting pot. After he destroys your country he lets a few of you come into his, and takes the brains of that country to help his own. It is modern slavery: back then you left your country in chains for the work field; today they make it so bad that you get on the plane on your own and come here to look for a job. Then the church convinces you it is okay to be broke, okay for your country to lie desolate while another man eats your riches. No, it is not okay. The earth belongs to us and it is coming back to us.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” Woe is destruction to him. Everything is ours and he is stealing it right under our eyes. In all the countries where we live, he controls the resources; we have enough to feed ourselves and do for ourselves, yet we are doing nothing.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee”: the other nations living within his country. There are sleeper cells in America and America knows it. How do you make a terrorist? Kill his mother, his father, his sons, his family, and he has nothing left to live for. Many of them are here as lawyers and school teachers, educated, working good jobs, and when they get that phone call they will remember their families, the way the Bible says Israel will remember their nature one day. America cannot stop it, because the Most High preordained it. Look at Deuteronomy 28: it was written about us, and we had no power to stop it. Once the Lord says it will happen, it happens.

As for me and my house, we are trying to serve the Lord. Do not draft me. They just raised the Army's enlistment age to 42, effective April 20th, 2026, because they know they will need more men, and the retired soldiers on the VA payroll will be called back. The young brothers are going to have decisions to make. The best thing any of us can do right now is get right with the Lord: enough with the bickering, the fighting, the grudging, the murmuring and the hatred. Our forefathers were killed in the wilderness for those things, and we are about to be delivered again from modern-day Egypt. Only those who do the Father's will shall be saved. Stay focused.

“And thou shalt be for booties unto them”: they are going to blaze up this place and rob it.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations”: look at the countries where they did a coup, destroyed the country and robbed it: Iran, Chile, Guatemala, where a fruit company orchestrated the coup to keep the people's bananas to sell in America, Indonesia, Ukraine, the Congo of Patrice Lumumba, Brazil, South Vietnam, Iraq, Syria, Venezuela, Cambodia, Greece, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Egypt, and Haiti twice, with two coups against Aristide. Thomas Sankara could not have been killed without the approval of the US, which still gets a piece of everything that comes out of Africa.

“All the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”: they spoiled the whole world, so the whole world is going to turn against them. “Because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land”: they have shed blood all over the world, so much blood is shed here, and much more will be shed.

“Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high”: who is doing space travel? Who invented the airplane? Who is putting satellites in orbit? Esau. Ain't no negro doing space traveling; one or two might be a cadet at NASA, but they are the ones doing it. In case you did not know who the scripture is talking about, the Bible tells you exactly who.

“Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.” Everything they have done is going to come right back to them, no matter how many boards of peace they create. Trump launched his board of peace out of Gaza, and after the meetings and the money, people are still getting killed. You create a board of peace and still go to war: what peace? There can never be peace, because they are not a peaceful people. Some people cannot sit still, and they cannot be at peace, because the sword is their blessing.

precepts.why:
Here is Esau, whose soul is not right in him. “But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little”: a war here, a war there, a storm here, a storm there, a tsunami here, a plague there. “Thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation”: the border of wickedness in Malachi is here a naughty generation, and as Hebrews said, there is no fornicator or profane person like him.

“And that their malice was bred in them”: their hatred was bred in them. When God created them, a couple of drops of hatred went in and it was put in the oven and baked; you cannot get it out of the dough once it is baked. What he is, that is what he is. The Lord created him that way.

“And that their cogitation would never be changed”: their way of thinking, their mind frame, will never change. They do things and do not even know why they do them. In Florida a man caring for handicapped children lay flat on the ground with his hands up, and the cop shot him, and when asked why, the cop said, I don't know. They are always possessed. Till this day bodies are found hanging in the South and the judgment is suicide, as if our brothers had superpowers to tie their own hands behind their backs and dunk their necks into the noose.

“For it was a cursed seed from the beginning”: Cain, cursed from the beginning, came back as Esau, cursed from the beginning. “Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned”: they cannot be pardoned.

So their malice is bred in them, they are a naughty generation, cursed from the beginning, their cogitation will never change, and no matter what they do they can never be pardoned for their sins. That is why his soul is not upright in him. Your pastor lied to you.

What is the wine he transgresses by? “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine”. The wine is the falsehood and the lying.

So Esau is a liar. He gave you the Protestants: lies. The Mormons: lies. The Seventh-day Adventists: lies. The Jehovah's Witnesses: lies. The Pentecostals, the Freemasons, the Rosicrucians, Thelema: lies. Every institution of doctrine he put on this earth for you to follow and worship is a lie, and all of them take you away from God.

sense.text:
“For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction”: you think there is going to be peace on earth? The Bible already tells you they are going to be destroyed.

“Cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child”: a woman in labor has increments of birth pains, and what we are watching right now is increments of birth pains. Besides Pearl Harbor, when did a navy carrier get hit the way Iran just hit America? Israel has bombarded many countries, but it has never been hit the way it is being hit now. The missiles are unstoppable; if Iran really wanted to destroy Israel right now it could, and Iran claims it could shoot missiles for ten years straight. The tide is slightly changing, so we are getting closer to the serious birth pains.

“And they shall not escape.” Because of what they have done to people, the whole earth wants their head. The whole earth wants to see America gone and Israel gone; turn on the news, no nation is really happy with America, and even Europe is slowly turning against it. Trump's board of peace costs a billion dollars to join and makes him chair for life, and hundreds have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire. They invited an Iranian negotiator to the table and bombed his country while he sat there negotiating. Esau is a different breed. You cannot trust his word to save your life. They want a little piece of everything, a piece of Greenland, Venezuela, Guatemala, Libya, and once they are done they leave you in pieces.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: he creates rules and policies that make him rich on the earth, like the board of peace that costs a billion dollars to join. He uses his policies to get rich. “And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: I'm the man.

“And by peace shall destroy many”: I come in peace, and I leave you in pieces.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand”: as 1 Thessalonians said, he is not going to escape. What he is doing on the earth now goes on for a little while, but eventually the whole earth will come up against him, Europe included. World War III is not going to be nice, and Esau is going to pay.

“Wherefore come out from among them”: stop doing the things they are doing and stop following their ways. “And be ye separate”: let go of his ways and start keeping God's ways. “Saith the Lord”: these are not my words; they were written long before I was born.

“And touch not the unclean thing”: your Christmas, let it go. Thanksgiving, let it go. Christianity, let it go. Your Masonry, your sororities and fraternities, let them go. Come out. “And I will receive you”: when you cleanse yourself of all the uncleanness this world has to offer, then the Lord will receive you.
“And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.” Then the Lord will be your father.

precepts.why: How do you come out from among them? Proverbs says to “choose none of his ways.” None. Who is the his? Esau, the oppressor. And who created Christianity? Esau. So you have to let Christianity go: no Jehovah's Witness, none of it.

The same thing in Revelation: “And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people”. In case you did not comprehend it in Corinthians, where it said saith the Lord Almighty, this time the voice speaks straight from heaven: come out of her, my people.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins”: that is the unclean thing, because in her is found every sort of profaneness and fornication. “And that ye receive not of her plagues”: if you partake of her sins, then when she is destroyed you will be destroyed with her.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” When God remembers your iniquities, he judges you. You have been warned; you have to come out of her.

sense.text:
“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God”. The churches do not teach you the commandments, so how are you going to be a saint if you do not keep the commandments as an Israelite? Come out.

“And the faith of Jesus”: Jesus the Christ. To get salvation you need both, the commandments and the faith of Jesus. There is no peace in America; America is going to be destroyed.

As the professor said at the beginning, black people cannot see white people for who they are; they trust white folks too much. The Bible says we cannot trust them. Never trust your enemy; your enemy will never teach you anything that is right, and all the churches you are in were given to you by your enemies. Come out of them so that you are not destroyed with America, because America will leave you in pieces.
